changed.statement:
∃ (n m d : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (edge : Bool)
    (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
  let nbrR := fun (a : Fin n) => Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin m => G a v = edge)
  let nbrC := fun (c : Fin m) => Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G u c = edge)
  2 ≤ d ∧
  (∀ a, 2 ≤ (nbrR a).card ∧ (nbrR a).card ≤ d) ∧
  (∀ c, 2 ≤ (nbrC c).card ∧ (nbrC c).card ≤ d) ∧
  (∀ a b, a ≠ b → ((nbrR a) ∩ (nbrR b)).card ≤ 1) ∧
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C ∧
  let negs := C.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  28 * d * C.size + 78 * d + 2 < (28 * d + 1) * (n + m) + 12 * d * negs

changed.title: Find a bounded nonlinear-depth selector exceeding the two-binomial-sum rank budget
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C ∧ depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 ∧
    budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d) < A.rank

changed.title: Which optimal depth-one one-hot fan-in-two banks can avoid mixing forbidden row-block pairs
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let F := ZMod 2
∀ (q l : ℕ) (s : Fin l → ℕ),
  let V := Fin q → F
  let I := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (2*s i)
  let M := Matrix I I F
  let dot := fun (a z : V) => ∑ k, a k * z k
  ∀ (a b : Fin l → V), (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    let line := fun i : Fin l => ({a i,b i,a i+b i} : Finset V)
    Function.Injective line →
    ∀ (U W : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (2*s i)) (Fin (2*s i)) F),
      (∀ i, (U i).rank = 2*s i ∧ (W i).rank = 2*s i ∧ (U i + W i).rank = 2*s i) →
      let K := fun (z : V) =>
        Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => dot (a i) z • U i + dot (b i) z • W i)
      ∀ t : ℕ, 2*t = 3*(∑ i, s i) →
        ∀ near : Fin l → Fin l → Bool, (∀ i, near i i = true) →
          (∀ i j, near i j = near j i) →
          let J := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (s i)
          let w := Fintype.card I
          let coord := Fintype.equivFin I
          let width := (w+1)+(w+1)
          let table := fun (z : V) (x y : Fin (w+1)) =>
            Fin.cases false (fun i => Fin.cases false (fun j =>
              decide (K z (coord.symm i) (coord.symm j) ≠ 0)) y) x
          let mixed := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (j : Fin C.gates.length)
              (x y : I) =>
            let val := fun (r c : Fin (w+1)) =>
              (⟨C.gates,width+j.val⟩ : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit).eval
                (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach r c)
            xor (xor (val (coord x).succ (coord y).succ) (val (coord x).succ 0))
              (xor (val 0 (coord y).succ) (val 0 0))
          let crossing := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
            ∑ j : Fin C.gates.length, if nonlinear (C.gates.get j) then
              @ite ℕ (∃ x y x' y' : I, near x.1 x'.1 = false ∧
                mixed C j x y = true ∧ mixed C j x' y' = true)
                (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0 else 0
          ∀ k : ℕ,
            (∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (tap : V → ℕ),
              PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack width C ∧
              (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t ∧
              crossing C ≤ k ∧ ∀ z : V, (depths width C).getD (tap z) 0 ≤ 1 ∧
                PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (table z) ⟨C.gates,tap z⟩) ↔
              ∃ mate : V → J → J,
                (∀ u x, u ∈ line x.1 → u ∈ line (mate u x).1 ∧
                  mate u x ≠ x ∧ mate u (mate u x) = x) ∧
                (∑ u : V, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : J =>
                  u ∈ line x.1 ∧ near x.1 (mate u x).1 = false)).card) ≤ 2*k

changed.title: Counting pairings of triples with at most two occurrences per name modulo powers of two reduces to linear families
changed.statement:
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let bits := fun (w x : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
∃ (f : List Bool → List Bool) (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (C : Nat),
  (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
  ∀ (n t : Nat) (H : Finset (Finset (Fin n))), (∀ R ∈ H, R.card = 3) →
    (∀ u : Fin n, (H.filter (fun R => u ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
    let Rows := Finset (Finset (Fin n))
    let count := fun (U : Finset (Fin n)) (F : Rows) (s : Nat) =>
      Nat.card {N : Rows // (∀ g ∈ N, g.card = 2 ∧ g ⊆ U) ∧
        (∀ g ∈ N, ∀ h ∈ N, g ≠ h → Disjoint g h) ∧
        (∀ R ∈ F, ∃ g ∈ N, g ⊆ R) ∧ N.card = s}
    let shared := (H.product H).image (fun z => z.1 ∩ z.2)
    let cores := shared.filter (fun c => c.card = 2)
    let ordinary := Finset.univ \ cores.biUnion id
    let base := H.filter (fun R => R ⊆ ordinary)
    let outer := fun c : Finset (Fin n) => (H.filter (fun R => c ⊆ R)).biUnion id \ c
    let left := fun S : Rows => ordinary \ S.biUnion outer
    let reduced := fun S : Rows => base.image (fun R => R ∩ left S)
    let hist := fun s : Nat => count Finset.univ H s
    let encode := header n ++ header t ++ H.toList.flatMap
      (fun R => R.toList.flatMap (fun u => bits (n.log2+1) u.val))
    (∀ S ⊆ cores, ∀ R ∈ reduced S, ∀ T ∈ reduced S, R ≠ T → (R ∩ T).card ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ s : Nat, hist s % (2^t) =
      ((cores.powerset.filter (fun S => S.card < t ∧ (S.biUnion outer).card = 2*S.card ∧
        cores.card+S.card ≤ s)).sum (fun S =>
          2^S.card * count (left S) (reduced S) (s-cores.card-S.card))) % (2^t)) ∧
    f encode = (List.range (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s => bits t (hist s)) ∧
    Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (encode.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
      (some ((f encode).map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) ((encode.length+2)^(t+C)))
